name: DUMBBELL SQUAT CLEAN AND PRESS
introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with your palms facing each other.\n\nPerform a squat movement. When you get up, bring the dumbbells to your shoulders, then lift them over your head. Return and repeat.

tips.text: Your knees shouldn\'t go over your toes when squatting down.
Push through your heels to get up.
This exercise works your glutes, quadriceps and shoulders.
